newsitem.title: UK: FTA calls for end to weekend loory bans in EU.
newsitem.headline: FTA calls for end to weekend loory bans in EU.

text.p: Britain's Freight Transport Association (FTA) said it has asked the European Commission "to remove the barriers to effective and efficient international trade caused by extended weekend and bank holiday lorry bans imposed in France, Italy, Luxembourg, Spain and elsewhere in Europe."

The FTA said in a statement that "the bans inhibit the operation of the single market by the backdoor. Though they are part of the domestic legislation of the countries concerned, they operate against the ideal of the international trade that constitutes the EU."

It quoted FTA executive director on transport policy, James Hookham as saying after a recent meeting with EC transport officials that:" These bans are causing unnecessary delays and disruptions to the free flow of goods, in particular from countries on the edge of the European Union like the UK.

"This is clearly against the spirit of what the EU stands for and we are expecting the Commission to demand immediate exceptions to the restrictions for international trade." - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
